titles: They Saw the Money… But Jimmy Was Already There
Jungle vs Desert: The Closest Finish Ever
clips.story: Three teams raced through the jungle, the desert and Antarctica to reach their rescue helicopters. First one there won $100,000 for their moms. After 28 hours, the desert team lost by 7 minutes and 44 seconds. 😭
clips.question: Who deserved it more?
clips.pinned: 7 minutes after 28 HOURS 😭 Would you be mad or proud? Be honest.
